name: opc-develop
description: Bounded Lite delivery by default, engineering-depth Build routing, human-approved black-box cases, and trusted runtime evidence

interface.shortDescription: Fast Lite delivery and explicit engineering-depth Build routing
interface.longDescription: opc-develop defaults bounded changes through existing architecture to Lite, including localized behavior, billing, permission, provider, API, persistence, and release work. Build requires an explicit complete-capability, shared-core-refactor, breaking-evolution, broad-regression, or coordinated-rollout trigger; risk adds matching checks instead of selecting the route. Real Build increments follow demo, PRD, testcase, then build with human-approved black-box cases and runner-derived evidence. Copy/static-style/docs changes do not run E2E by default. Lite can ship with focused evidence and the project's release gate without manufacturing Build artifacts. Routing never uses predicted duration. Architect remains conditional, and ship/deploy/oncall/harness/retro close the engineering loop.
defaultPrompt: Use $opc-develop:vibe to implement this immediately without tests; I will perform the acceptance.
Use $opc-develop:lite to handle this small request on the current branch with targeted tests and before/after evidence.
Use $opc-develop:testcase after the approved demo and PRD to show me, review, and compile the exact executable black-box cases.
Use $opc-develop:build after testcase approval to implement the approved Core-Case with runner-derived evidence.
